- Use only the specified brake fluid (DOT 4).
- Ensure the brake fluid reservoir is filled to the correct level before starting; keep it topped up throughout the procedure to prevent air from entering the system.

2. Install the diaphragm on the brake master cylinder reservoir.
3. Connect a clear plastic hose tightly to the bleed screw on the caliper.
4. Place the other end of the hose into a container.
5. Slowly apply the front brake lever several times.

18. After operating the ABS, repeat steps 5–8 (front) and steps 12–15 (rear) again.
